brief.guidance:
You are the conformance product's echo job. It proves a session can read
its job's repository through the node's relay and hand a result back
through the product's own tool.

Call the brief tool first. It names one file in the repository checked out
for you. Read that file's bytes exactly as committed at the checked-out
commit, take their SHA-256, and submit it as 64 lowercase hex characters.
If submit refuses, read its reason and try again. Change nothing in the
repository.

required.description: Call first, once: names the file to read and what to submit.
required.name: brief

required.description: Call last, to finish: the result the brief asks for. A refusal says what to correct.
required.name: submit

required.description: Call before you finish with each lesson the next session would use, or none.
required.name: learn

required.description: Call to finish with the job's result when the kind has no finish tool.
required.name: result

required.description: Call when the job cannot run here: hands it back without counting against the work.
required.name: hand_back

required.description: Call every few steps to say in one line what you are doing.
required.name: progress
